policy_title: Scale Up Nuclear Power with Small Modular Reactors
stated: The Conservative Party will scale up nuclear power by approving two new fleets of Small Modular Reactors within the first 100 days of the next Parliament, aiming to rapidly expand nuclear power, create jobs, and deliver cheaper, cleaner energy by halving approval times.

source.quote: Scale up nuclear power, building on our work establishing Great British Nuclear. Within the first 100 days of the next Parliament, we will approve two new fleets of Small Modular Reactors to rapidly expand nuclear power, create well-paid, high-skilled jobs and deliver cheaper, cleaner and more secure energy.

bearing_set.reason: Expanding nuclear generation directly affects the UK's emissions trajectory and low-carbon energy mix, earning a genuine verdict on climate and clean energy outcomes.
The policy explicitly claims cheaper energy as an aim; energy bills are a core cost-of-living indicator, so the credibility of that price-reduction claim earns a real verdict here.
Policy explicitly cites job creation; nuclear construction and operation generates skilled, secure employment, directly moving employment-rate and job-quality indicators.
Domestic nuclear generation reduces dependence on imported fossil fuels, directly improving resilience to external energy-supply threats — an O5 indicator.

Domestic energy infrastructure at scale affects energy security, business competitiveness, and long-term productivity — aggregate living-standards effects distinct from household bill prices (O2) and job distribution (O4).

membership_note: Four genuine bearings: cheaper energy (O2), explicit job creation (O4), low-carbon power (O6), and long-term energy-infrastructure productivity gains (O13). O5 (energy security/resilience) was considered but the policy mechanism is primarily economic and environmental rather than a direct defence/security posture shift. O12 was considered but the policy text concerns regulatory approval, not explicit public funding commitments, so a public-finance bearing cannot be mechanistically pinned from the stated text.
